title: Eastham Library Art Show Reception May 10
paragraphs: The Guild of Harwich Artists is proud to announce our April Art Show hosted by the Eastham Public Library located at 190 Samoset Rd, Eastham, MA 02642. bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden April 3, 2025

The Guild of Harwich Artists is proud to announce our April Art Show hosted by the Eastham Public Library located at 190 Samoset Rd, Eastham, MA 02642. The art work is available for viewing during regular hours: Mondays 12-4pm, Tuesdays & Thursdays 10-8pm, and Wednesdays, Fridays & Saturdays 10-4pm.  A free public reception with refreshments was held on Thursday, May 10, 5-7pm in the library.  Art work is available for purchase at the Library.
